comparison.objective: Install round and diamond locating pins and load a bracket onto them.
comparison.physical_skill: Pin selection/orientation, precision fixture insertion, and two-hole part seating.
comparison.success_condition: Correct pin set home, diamond oriented properly, bracket fully seated and stable, hands clear.
comparison.reason: Precision locating and slip-fit seating are different from breaking sacrificial insert tangs while preserving the surrounding coils.
